name: China personal identifiers
description: Local redaction for selected China mainland resident ID, mobile and labelled UnionPay card patterns. This is bounded data-loss screening, not identification, consent management, sensitive-personal-information governance, or PIPL compliance.

rules.name: PRC resident identity card number
rules.description: Redacts 18-character resident identity card candidates only after birth-date and MOD 11-2 checksum validation. It does not verify issuance, holder identity, or the six-digit administrative division code.

rules.name: China mainland mobile number
rules.description: Redacts standalone +86/86-prefixed or domestic 11-digit mobile-number patterns. It does not verify allocation, ownership, or whether a number identifies a person in context.

rules.name: Contextual UnionPay card number
rules.description: Redacts labelled 16–19 digit 62-prefixed card candidates that pass a Luhn check. It does not identify every Chinese bank account, establish ownership, or validate account status.
rules.context_expression: (?i)(?:银行卡(?:号)?|卡号|借记卡|信用卡|bank\s*card|card\s*(?:number|no\.?))

name: China organization identifiers
description: Local redaction for explicitly labelled Unified Social Credit Code candidates after checksum validation. The code identifies an organization rather than, by itself, a natural person; this Policy does not classify it as personal information or establish confidentiality.

rules.name: Contextual Unified Social Credit Code
rules.description: Redacts an 18-character candidate only when a nearby Chinese label is present and the GB 32100 checksum is valid. It does not verify registration or organization status.
rules.context_expression: (?:统一社会信用代码|社会信用代码|统一信用代码)

name: Chinese prompt manipulation
description: Local screening for selected explicit Chinese instruction-override, prompt-extraction and jailbreak-mode phrases. It is a defense-in-depth control and does not eliminate prompt injection.

rules.name: Chinese instruction override
rules.description: Rejects selected explicit Chinese phrases that ask the model to ignore, override, or bypass trusted instructions. It does not detect arbitrary paraphrases or establish instruction trust.
rules.expression: (?:忽略|无视|绕过|覆盖).{0,8}(?:之前|此前|以上|原有|系统|开发者).{0,6}(?:指令|提示词|规则)

rules.name: Chinese prompt extraction request
rules.description: Rejects selected explicit Chinese requests to reveal or reproduce protected system or developer instructions. It does not prevent every disclosure path.
rules.expression: (?:显示|泄露|输出|复述|告诉我).{0,8}(?:系统提示词|系统指令|开发者指令)

rules.name: Chinese unrestricted-mode request
rules.description: Rejects selected explicit Chinese requests to enter jailbreak, developer, or unrestricted mode. It is a phrase control, not a semantic jailbreak detector.
rules.expression: (?:进入|开启|切换到).{0,4}(?:越狱|无限制|开发者)模式

name: China banking assistant boundaries
description: Local Chinese/English text boundaries for verification-code theft, assistant credential solicitation, identity-check evasion, and selected misleading return guarantees. It does not make banking decisions, perform KYC/AML, assess suitability, or establish financial-regulatory compliance.

rules.name: Verification-code theft request
rules.description: Rejects selected explicit requests to steal, trick, or collect a customer's verification code, dynamic password, payment password, or card PIN. It is not transaction-fraud monitoring.
rules.expression: (?i)(?:骗取|套取|窃取|盗取|收集).{0,10}(?:客户|用户)?.{0,4}(?:短信)?(?:验证码|动态口令|支付密码|银行卡密码)|\b(?:steal|harvest|trick\s+(?:a\s+)?customer\s+into\s+sharing)\b.{0,32}\b(?:OTP|one-time password|verification code|card PIN)\b

rules.name: Assistant solicitation of sensitive credentials
rules.description: Rejects selected response phrases directing a customer to send a verification code, dynamic password, payment password, or card PIN. It cannot determine whether an authenticated channel or approved workflow applies.
rules.expression: (?i)(?!(?:请勿|请不要|不要|无需|不需要))(?:请|需要|务必).{0,8}(?:提供|告知|发送|回复).{0,12}(?:短信验证码|验证码|动态口令|支付密码|银行卡密码)|\b(?:please|you need to|you must)\s+(?:send|share|provide|reply with)\s+(?:your\s+)?(?:OTP|one-time password|verification code|card PIN)\b

rules.name: Bank identity-check evasion
rules.description: Rejects selected explicit Chinese or English requests to bypass bank identity verification, customer due diligence, or anti-money-laundering checks. It does not perform KYC or AML decisions.
rules.expression: (?i)(?:帮我|教我|如何|怎么).{0,6}(?:绕过|规避|跳过).{0,6}(?:银行)?(?:身份验证|实名认证|客户尽职调查|反洗钱检查)|\b(?:help me|show me how to)\s+(?:bypass|evade)\s+(?:bank\s+)?(?:KYC|AML|identity verification)\b

rules.name: Assistant investment-return guarantee
rules.description: Rejects selected positive response claims that a named product or the bank guarantees principal, profit, or return. It does not assess suitability, disclosure completeness, product terms, or financial-advice legality.
rules.expression: (?:本产品|该产品|我们|我行)(?![^，。！？]{0,6}(?:无法|不能|不会|不|未)).{0,6}(?:保证|承诺).{0,10}(?:保本|收益|回报|盈利)|(?:本产品|该产品).{0,6}稳赚不赔|(?i:\b(?:this product|our bank|we)\s+guarantees?\s+(?:your\s+)?(?:principal|profit|returns?)\b)
